sentence_stem: What the committee had not anticipated
correct_completion: was the sheer volume of public objections.
full_sentence: What the committee had not anticipated was the sheer volume of public objections.
acceptable_variants: was the scale of public opposition.
was how many people objected publicly.

options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result clause and cannot complete a wh-clause that needs a complement introduced by 'was'.

options.text: were the members, who arrived late.
options.why_wrong: The verb 'were' does not agree with the singular wh-clause subject, and the result makes no sensible contrast or identification.

options.text: was the sheer volume of public objections.
although the agenda was already approved.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals concession and needs a main clause, so it cannot serve as the complement of the wh-clause.

grammar_focus: Wh-noun clauses as subjects with a 'was' complement
explanation: The wh-clause 'What the committee had not anticipated' is a nominal clause acting as the subject, so it needs a complement introduced by 'was' to complete its meaning. Only the option that names the unexpected noun phrase fits this pattern.
translation: Lo que el comité no había previsto fue el enorme volumen de objeciones públicas.
